name: game-arcade
description: A React-based arcade for browser games. Pick a game from the dashboard and play. The arcade currently ships with **Tic Tac Toe** in two modes — two-player and vs. Computer (Bot) — with more games on the way.

paragraphs: A React-based arcade for browser games. Pick a game from the dashboard and play. The arcade currently ships with Tic Tac Toe in three modes — two-player (local), vs. Computer (Bot), and online multiplayer across two devices — with more games on the way.
Built with React 19, React Router 7, and Vite on the front end, and a small Node + Socket.IO server for real-time online play.
features: Game dashboard — a landing screen that lists available games as cards, with routing to each game.
Local two-player on one board with X/O turns.
vs. Bot — play the computer; you are X.
Online multiplayer — two people on different devices play the same match live. Share a room link; the server is authoritative and validates every move.
Live status banner showing whose turn it is, the winner, or a draw.
